16:   let gameOver = false;

18:   // ----- Input -----

21:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
22:   canvas.addEventListener('click', e => {
23:     if (gameOver) return;
24:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
25:     const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
26:     // fire from ship center
27:     lasers.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, dx: (mx - ship.x) * 0.1, dy: -5 });
28:   });

31:   function spawnMeteor() {
32:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 20; // 20-40
33:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
34:     const y = -size;
35:     const speed = Math.random() * 1 + 0.5;
36:     meteors.push({ x, y, size, speed, dx: 0, dy: speed });
37:   }
38: 
39:   function splitMeteor(m) {
40:     if (m.size < 15) return;
41:     const newSize = m.size / 2;
42:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
43:       meteors.push({
44:         x: m.x + Math.random() * 5,
45:         y: m.y + Math.random() * 5,
46:         size: newSize,
47:         speed: m.speed * 1.2,
48:         dx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,

50:       });
51:     }
52:   }

54:   function rectCircleCollide(rx, ry, rw, rh, cx, cy, cr) {
55:     // approximate with distance to rect center
56:     const dx = Math.abs(cx - (rx + rw / 2));
57:     const dy = Math.abs(cy - (ry + rh / 2));
58:     if (dx > (rw / 2 + cr) || dy > (rh / 2 + cr)) return false;
59:     if (dx <= (rw / 2) || dy <= (rh / 2)) return true;

91:       const m = meteors[i];

114:       }
115:     }
116:

119:   }

127:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
128:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);

136:       ctx.fill();

140:     lasers.forEach(l => {
141:       ctx.fillRect(l.x - 2, l.y - 10, 4, 10);
142:     });

144:     ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
145:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
147:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, 10, 40);

151:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
154:     }
155:   }
